bundle.longDescription: Alice answers your questions about Bitcoin, explains what you are looking at on the chain and teaches the subject at your own pace. She runs on your device or through encrypted inference you can verify, and she never sees your keys. Alice App includes an Explorer, a Learn library of courses and a Playground where you practise wallet moves with test coins.
